formulas.title: Genuine source geometry and minimal physical alphabet
formulas.scope: Common original W(3,s) typed global-injection model; h>=1. This defines the minimal alphabet, not an inequality about S_s.
formulas.not_implies: A count of source vertices or physical labels alone is not a GF(5) obstruction.

formulas.title: D6 ensemble probability and expectation
formulas.scope: h>=1, expectation over two independent UNIFORM COMPLETE globally injected original typed maps; M_6 is the original source six-edge matching count.
formulas.not_implies: Positive average does NOT imply \inf_{f,g}D_6>0 or \inf_{f,g}S_s=\Omega(s^6).

formulas.title: Original GQ anchor dirty-pencil identities
formulas.scope: Every fixed legal globally injected f,g; probability ONLY over uniformly sampled ORIGINAL nonincident GQ point-line pairs.
formulas.not_implies: Does not control four correlated original anchors conditional on a physical I1 template.

formulas.title: Quenched right-map exact B/A conditional identity
formulas.scope: h>=1; for each FIXED complete global right injection g, average over ONE independently drawn uniform complete global left injection f.
formulas.not_implies: No individual-f or all-f,g guarantee follows from the identity.

formulas.title: All-right-map conditional expected B/A lower bound
formulas.scope: h>=3; every fixed g, uniform random globally injected f. Implies min_g max_f lower; does NOT imply min_(f,g) lower.
formulas.not_implies: Does not establish Root Branch A or bound the simultaneous adversarial minimax.

formulas.title: Deterministic all-h five-original-point quintic charge
formulas.scope: h>=1; EVERY fixed coherent legal f,g, original six-incidence supports; quintic in constrained one-hot assignments.
formulas.not_implies: Nonnegative coefficients do not imply the polynomial has a uniformly positive minimum.

formulas.title: Exact global-injection-preserving two-label swap
formulas.scope: h>=1; global swap of assigned physical pair labels on two distinct original points u,v with same fixed g.
formulas.not_implies: One-transposition local optimality is not a global minimax or counterfamily certificate.

formulas.title: Exact all-h seven-positive-class same-original-ID two-sided join
formulas.scope: h>=1; every genuine original W(3,2^h) and every pair of separately globally injective complete f,g; intersections are sets of SAME six genuine original incidence IDs; D6 requires physical original-column cycle alignment.
formulas.not_implies: Exact join identity is not an all-maps lower bound on simultaneous seven-GF5 positive original motifs.

formulas.title: GQ original-incidence source C/C impossibility
formulas.scope: h>=1; six DISTINCT genuine original incidence IDs, both typed ORIGINAL source multiplicity profiles C=(2,2,2), arbitrary complete physical global injections.
formulas.not_implies: Forbids genuine original source C/C only; not a generic physical coordinate C/C intersection or a deterministic positive seven-GF5 minimum.

formulas.title: Exact fixed-point-map original D6 conditional alignment probability and count
formulas.scope: s=2^h>=8; every fixed complete global original point injection f, one uniformly sampled complete globally injected original line map g, shared across all genuine six-distinct-incidence sets.
formulas.not_implies: A positive expectation does not imply D6(f,g)>0 under an adversarially fixed right g.

formulas.title: Deterministic occupied coordinate C6 and true original distinct-source-flag bound
formulas.latex: m=K-V,\quad 0\le m\le a-2,\quad C_s=\frac{(a)_6}{12}-m(a-2)_4,\quad N_{\mathrm{left\,C6,AA}}(f)\ge C_s(s+1)_6.
formulas.scope: s=2^h>=8, physical alphabet a minimal with binom(a,2)>=V; fixed full globally injected original point map f; (s+1)_6 counts distinct original line choices via the true source incidence degree.
formulas.not_implies: Occupied physical six-cycles are only left candidates, not individually accepted D6 motifs for every fixed globally injected g.

formulas.title: Every fixed f direct original D6 conditional mean lower
formulas.scope: h>=3; fixed arbitrary complete original global point injection f and a SINGLE uniformly random complete original global line injection g; exact finite s=8..128 checks plus all s>=256 source inequalities.
formulas.not_implies: min_f max_g S>=s^6/8 is not min_(f,g) S>=s^6/8; no probability concentration is asserted.

formulas.title: True original GQ-dual fixed g direct D6 conditional lower
formulas.scope: h>=3; every fixed complete original globally injected line map g; f uniformly sampled from complete globally injected original point physical-edge maps using true original W(3,s) point-line incidence duality.
formulas.not_implies: Does not imply a universal pointwise bound for every f,g nor a full seven-class root theorem.
